description: Source code implementing certificate utility functions for Windows in the Chromium project, including certificate creation, fingerprint calculation, and self-signed certificate verification.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate used in Chromium's network security code.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromCertContexts
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from certificate contexts and an optional creation options parameter.

methods.name: CreateCertContextWithChain
methods.description: Creates a certificate context with chain, including handling of intermediate certificates.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate context.

methods.name: IsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is self-signed by verifying its signature and comparing subject and issuer names.
